ifo Business Climate Index Germany

The ifo Business Climate Index is a widely observed early indicator for economic development in Germany. Monthly results are released at 10:30 CET/CEST on the following dates:

  • 22 January 2026 10:30 CET/CEST
  • 24 February 2026 10:30 CET/CEST
  • 25 March 2026 10:30 CET/CEST
  • 24 April 2026 10:30 CET/CEST
  • 22 May 2026 10:30 CET/CEST
  • 24 June 2026 10:30 CET/CEST
  • 27 July 2026 10:30 CET/CEST
